testcase.name: the skipped-feature notice speaks only when something was requested and skipped
a single request round trips through the work input map
malformed or unknown inputs decode to null instead of a half request
an old request without a format key decodes to pdf and a bad one rejects the whole request
a malformed layout rejects the whole request instead of falling back
an edited request without a draft id is rejected instead of becoming an empty paper
an old request without layout keys decodes to the default layout
a layout survives the work input round trip for both request kinds
a batch request round trips and keeps entry ids in order
an edited request round trips with its draft id layout and format
a batch of a hundred ids stays far below the work data limit
a format survives the work input round trip for both request kinds
the worker runs whenever the book is usable and only waits for a closed database
unique work is named per export so one record cannot stack two jobs
